premises.text: Future devices will continuously listen, understand conversation, and anticipate needed information
premises.evidence_span: the computing devices all around us will pay attention continuously. They will understand what we say in our conversations

premises.text: MindMeld is a voice/video calling app that understands speech to surface relevant information
premises.evidence_span: the first voice and video calling app that actually understands what you say in order to put relevant information right at your fingertips

premises.text: Anticipatory computing engine models the last ~10 minutes of talk to anticipate the next ~10 seconds of needs
premises.evidence_span: it analyzes the last 10 minutes of your conversation to anticipate what you might need in the next 10 seconds

premises.text: Engine proactively finds relevant information from across the web
premises.evidence_span: we use that model to proactively find relevant information from across the web

premises.text: Shared workspace lets callers drag items to a real-time sharing panel, organized and archived
premises.evidence_span: the sharing panel in this application is a shared workspace where everything that everyone sees is automatically done in real time

premises.text: Nine patents cover the core anticipatory computing IP
premises.evidence_span: There's nine patents that cover the core IP

premises.text: Developer platform will let third parties build new intelligent applications on the engine
premises.evidence_span: we're opening up our developer platform early next year so that developers and third parties can build new applications

value.text: Save painful conversations by putting needed facts at users' fingertips during calls
value.evidence_span: make painful conversations like this one a thing of the past

secondary_value.text: Power continuous anticipatory apps beyond the iPad calling client
secondary_value.evidence_span: power this emerging generation of intelligent applications
